fixed.base_note: The base rate at 800 kWh ($77.17) is the reference bill minus the riders. The split between the monthly fixed charge (about $8, as reported by the press for 2026) and the per-kWh charge is approximate; the exact values are in the tariff book approved in NEPR-AP-2023-0003.
